semantics.reference_rule: Nested Routine target is an exact canonical Routine identity.
semantics.composition_rule: Parent Routine references child Routine definition without copying its semantics.
semantics.execution_rule: Child invocation creates its own nested Runner/execution scope according to runner policy.
semantics.output_rule: Child outputs returned to parent are explicit and provenance-bearing.
semantics.recursion_rule: Recursive Routine composition is allowed only under explicit finite recursion/reentry bounds.
semantics.history_rule: Execution trace preserves parent and child Routine/execution identities.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions are explicit canonical ordered compositions of exact commands/operations/routines; runtime execution state is never embedded into the reusable definition.

hard_gates.condition: nested Routine copied into parent as duplicate authority
